notes: The Drowned Belfry (dungeon_belfry). templates\belfry_template.flp = kiln_template3 with choir = Ah Voice (insert 4), timpani channel = Clock Bell (insert 1), bell_marrow = Analog Harp (insert 7), harp channel = Saint Eustache church organ (+12, insert 2), brass_low = 12 Low Strings (+12, Osc2 off, Osc1 7.32, insert 8). v2 (review v1 MAJOR): the Clock Bell's loudest partial is a major tenth above each note (ratio ~2.49), so insert 1 cuts 10 dB at 1.45 kHz and high-cuts at 3 kHz; harp target -33.5 (its arpeggio bars swelled the mix 2.7 dB). The organ and bass ignore velocity, so at_ticks did nothing there.
